# Rieke Lab OS

> A local browser workspace for Symphony recordings, metadata queries, annotations,
> and MATLAB/SQLite exports. Repository: https://github.com/maxwellsdm1867/Rieke-OS

## Start here

- [Overview, full download, and requirements](README.md)
- [Quick start: install through first export](docs/RIEKE_OS_QUICK_START.md)
- [LLM installation instructions](docs/LLM_SETUP.md)
- [Workspace reference](workspace-app/README.md)
- [Optional MATLAB/EpicTreeGUI companion](EPIC_TREE_GUIDE.md)
- [Packaging and validation scope](packaging/README.md)

## Setup contract

Download the whole repository. From its root, run sh install.sh, then sh start.sh.
The default browser URL is http://127.0.0.1:8766. Next time use sh start.sh again.
Installation downloads application-local dependencies; this is not an offline
or signed desktop installer. New projects use native MySQL without Docker.
Existing Docker-backed projects retain their backend. MATLAB is optional.
Apple Silicon macOS is verified; other macOS/Linux targets are experimental.
Windows is unsupported. No LLM account or API key is required by the app.

Keep scientific workspaces separate from the application. Preserve dependency
pins, project identities, original H5 files, and private credentials. Exports
reference original recordings. Report actual verification, not assumed success.
